next.reason: 1985: the files of one CLOSE 'need not all have the same organization or access'. 2023 states no rule requiring them to match, and §2023:14.9.6.4 GR10 makes a multi-file CLOSE 'the same as if a separate CLOSE statement had been written for each file-name-1', so a mixed CLOSE is valid with the same effect. (The per-file phrase limits of §2023:14.9.6.3 SR1 are separate 1985 rules.)
